rows.Name: Shearling-collar leather jacket
rows.Summary: A 1970s brown leather jacket with a curly shearling collar and cuffs.
rows.Description: The leather has a lovely worn-in grain, darker at the seams, and the shearling trim is full and clean. All snaps work and the lining was replaced at some point in a matching brown.

rows.Name: Rust twill jacket
rows.Summary: A boxy rust-orange cotton twill jacket with snap buttons.
rows.Description: Heavy cotton twill faded to a warm rust, with press studs down the front and a point collar. Cut short and square, easy over a knit.

rows.Name: Faded denim trucker jacket
rows.Summary: A classic light-blue denim jacket with copper buttons and flap pockets.
rows.Description: Soft, properly broken-in denim with the fading exactly where it should be: collar, cuffs and pocket flaps. Leather-look patch inside the collar, no holes.

rows.Name: Light-wash straight jeans
rows.Summary: High-rise, straight-leg jeans in a pale sun-bleached wash.
rows.Description: Rigid cotton denim with no stretch, so they hold their shape and mould to you. Five pockets, button fly, a paper-look back patch.

rows.Name: Terracotta canvas overshirt
rows.Summary: A garment-dyed cotton canvas overshirt in faded terracotta.
rows.Description: Two patch pockets on the chest, horn-look buttons and a small leather tab at the neck. The dye has softened unevenly, which is exactly its charm.

rows.Name: Rose print tea dress
rows.Summary: A dark floral tea dress with puff shoulders and a velvet-trimmed waist.
rows.Description: Sheer crepe printed with dusky roses on black, a wrap-effect V-neck and three-quarter sleeves. Fully lined skirt, falls to mid-calf.

rows.Name: Sheer black tie-front blouse
rows.Summary: A cropped sheer black blouse with balloon sleeves and a long tie.
rows.Description: Fine chiffon that ties at the front, with gathered sleeves and narrow cuffs. Wear it over a slip or a fitted vest.

rows.Name: Striped wool jumper
rows.Summary: A hand-knit crew-neck in raspberry with a purple rib and brown stripe.
rows.Description: Someone knitted this by hand and it shows in the best way. Thick wool, a slightly uneven purple rib at the neck and a band of brown across the body.

rows.Name: Red rib-knit cardigan
rows.Summary: A cropped cardigan in bright red chunky rib with gold buttons.
rows.Description: A generous boxy shape with dropped shoulders and a deep V. The rib is springy and the colour is still strong.

rows.Name: Western leather boots
rows.Summary: Tan cowboy boots with stitched shafts and a scuffed, polished toe.
rows.Description: Proper pull-on western boots with a stacked heel and a decorative stitch pattern up the shaft. The toes are scuffed and have been polished over, the soles have plenty of life.

rows.Name: Leather doctor's bag
rows.Summary: A black leather Gladstone bag with a hinged frame and a single handle.
rows.Description: Heavy, polished leather that has been looked after for decades. The metal frame opens wide and locks shut. A statement piece for travel or a desk.

rows.Name: Tooled leather saddle bag
rows.Summary: A tan hand-tooled leather shoulder bag with whipstitched edges.
rows.Description: Hand-tooled floral panels, a leather-covered button and a long adjustable strap. The kind of bag that gets better with every year it is carried.

rows.Name: Woven frame handbag
rows.Summary: A black woven box bag with a gold-tone frame handle.
rows.Description: A small, rigid box shape in woven black straw with a brass handle and clasp. Lined in black fabric, clean inside.

rows.Name: Embroidered evening purse
rows.Summary: A frame purse embroidered with gold thread in a heraldic pattern.
rows.Description: Petit-point and gold thread embroidery on a black ground, a kiss-lock clasp and a fine chain handle. Too good to keep in a drawer.

rows.Name: Tortoiseshell cat-eye sunglasses
rows.Summary: Oversized cat-eye frames in warm tortoiseshell with grey lenses.
rows.Description: Thick acetate frames with a lifted upper edge and grey lenses. The hinges are tight and the lenses are unscratched.

rows.Name: Linen market tote
rows.Summary: A large brown linen tote with long leather handles.
rows.Description: Washed linen in a deep brown with a patch pocket on the front and rust leather handles riveted at the top. Holds a week of groceries.
